extends Node3D

func _ready():
	# base e palo
	add_child(Shapes.cylinder(0.28, 0.2, 8, "ferro_scuro"))
	var pole := Shapes.cylinder(0.08, 3.2, 6, "ferro_scuro")
	pole.position = Vector3(0, 0.2, 0)
	add_child(pole)
	# lanterna emissiva
	var lantern := Shapes.box(Vector3(0.5, 0.5, 0.5), "luce_calda")
	lantern.position = Vector3(0, 3.65, 0)
	add_child(lantern)
	# tettuccio
	var cap := Shapes.cone(0.4, 0.3, 4, "ferro_scuro")
	cap.position = Vector3(0, 3.9, 0)
	add_child(cap)
	# luce calda
	var light := OmniLight3D.new()
	light.light_color = Color("#ffb347")
	light.light_energy = 2.0
	light.omni_range = 9.0
	light.shadow_enabled = false
	light.position = Vector3(0, 3.5, 0)
	add_child(light)
description: Lampione low-poly da giardino: palo scuro alto 3.9 m, lanterna emissiva calda e OmniLight color ambra.
name: lampione_prototipo
